name: The Cute, Light and Fluffy Project
source:
An anthology of four short games with the common theme of cute, light, and fluffy.

Stories included:
"Five Minutes"
"My Eternal Rival"
"Cloud Fairy"
"Cuter than Fiction"
translation:
收錄四款短篇遊戲，都走可愛、輕鬆又溫馨的路線。

收錄故事：
《Five Minutes》
《My Eternal Rival》
《Cloud Fairy》
《Cuter than Fiction》
